description: This is a modern 'Nodes View' dashboard for your Kubernetes cluster(s). Made for kube-prometheus-stack and take advantage of the latest Grafana features. GitHub repository: https://github.com/dotdc/grafana-dashboards-kubernetes

targets.expr:
max by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{instance="$instance", cluster="$cluster"})
- max by (instance) (node_memory_MemFree_bytes{instance="$instance", cluster="$cluster"})
- (
    max by (instance) (node_memory_Cached_bytes{instance="$instance", cluster="$cluster"})
  + max by (instance) (node_memory_Buffers_bytes{instance="$instance", cluster="$cluster"})
  )

max by (instance) (node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{instance="$instance", cluster="$cluster"})
- max by (instance) (node_memory_SwapFree_bytes{instance="$instance", cluster="$cluster"})

max(kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{node="$node", cluster="$cluster"}) by (persistentvolumeclaim, namespace) / max(kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{node="$node", cluster="$cluster"}) by (persistentvolumeclaim, namespace)

100 - ((max by (instance, device, mountpoint, fstype) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="$instance", cluster="$cluster"}) * 100) / max by (instance, device, mountpoint, fstype) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="$instance", cluster="$cluster"}))

100 - (max by (instance, device, mountpoint, fstype) (node_filesystem_files_free{instance="$instance", cluster="$cluster"}) / max by (instance, device, mountpoint, fstype) (node_filesystem_files{instance="$instance", cluster="$cluster"}) * 100)

title: Kubernetes / Views / Nodes
